supersedes: The exclusive common-50 continuation candidate; the first common endpoint remains 25.
decision_after: Both CDRM seeds have completed their already frozen 25-epoch runs.
decision_inputs: Remaining time to the original training cutoff and observed end-to-end per-epoch duration of all four members; no accuracy-dependent allocation.
reason: The observed approximately 0.89 second CDRM update plus evaluation/checkpoint overhead makes 50 epochs tight. A common 45-epoch endpoint provides additional learning evidence while keeping a 15 percent time margin and the original finalization reserve.
time_estimate: For each member, multiply its full observed elapsed_seconds / completed_epochs by requested additional epochs. Sum all four members, add 60 seconds for continuation startup/checkpoint overhead, and multiply by 1.15. Choose the first candidate whose estimate fits the remaining training window.
constraints: No independent hyperparameter or gate changes.
No outcome-dependent continuation of a subset.
Keep epoch-25 artifacts and the original 200-epoch scheduler state.
Generate/evaluate final data only after the endpoint choice and checkpoint-selection rules are frozen.
